    0429d795f79a0665afeca565e5a05c87ab4ba1e2 and pyharp 4721715855e937c1e8b218e964c0655f46e56e29 (the constants and the
    rotor kernel `h2_rot`, whose constants and weights the port uses); deck: the element weights and temperature grids in
    `src/snapy_report/ch02/checks/h2he_check.py`; run: `python src/snapy_report/ch02/checks/h2he_check.py`, CPU float64,
    one process; Python 3.11.13, numpy 2.4.6, sympy 1.14.0; output identical to the committed file]. Fourteen checks
    cover deck molar-mass and heat-capacity arithmetic (C1–C10) and sampled or limiting H$_2$ rotor heat capacities
    (C11–C14): equilibrium $c_p/R=3.50018$ at 1000 K, normal $2.50000$ at 20 K, and on a 0.5 K grid an equilibrium
    maximum of 4.56869 at 50.5 K over 40–120 K and a normal maximum of 3.25225 over 20–200 K. They do not re-derive
    the ideal-moist factors, the energy equation or the adiabatic index. Output:
    `src/snapy_report/ch02/checks/h2he_check.out`. This is an independent port and algebra check, not a run of snapy or
    kintera.
